Text: “May add 2 pilots and 3 passengers. During your control phase, may peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck; may place it on Used Pile (if card is an assassin, may take it into hand).” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
